headline: Binance Takes In 1,183.0 Million Dollars Of A 1,212.9 Million Dollar Exchange Inflow
narrative: Exchanges took in 1,212.9 million dollars over 24 hours, 0.4524 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means money arrived where holders can sell, and Binance took in 1,183.0 million dollars of that intake. Bitget shed 56.2 million dollars, while Bybit took in 33.9 million and OKX took in 25.9 million.
author: jordan
